data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: calibration-report.sh monthly produces a rollup comment on calibration-program-health whose channel counts exactly match a synthetic fixture's known detected_by distribution
- dd-4: calibration-report.sh declares its bucket-boundary timezone as UTC in a single shared location used by all subcommands
- dd-5: Fixture-driven correctness test (tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs and a separate synthetic distribution) runs locally and asserts exact channel counts

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh as a self-contained bash script (set -euo pipefail) with a subcommand dispatcher (case statement) and the `monthly` subcommand. Declare `readonly CALIBRATION_TZ='UTC'` as the single shared timezone constant (dd-4). The monthly subcommand:
- Resolves the target period (current month in UTC by default; `--period YYYY-MM` override).
- Aggregates bug tickets by `detected_by:<channel>` tag using `${DSO} ticket list --type=bug --format=llm` + `${DSO} ticket show <id>` parsing. The `--fixture <path>` flag reads pre-canned JSON instead of calling DSO.
- Posts rollup as comment on calibration-program-health. Comment body MUST begin with `<!-- calibration-rollup: period=YYYY-MM kind=monthly -->` marker.
- Supports `--dry-run` (print rollup to stdout, skip CLI post).
- Uses `DSO="${DSO:-$(dirname "$0")/dso}"` env-var override pattern (matches dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh).

Create tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/ with JSON files representing synthetic bug tickets with a KNOWN detected_by distribution (at least 5 bugs across at least 3 channels). Also create a separate synthetic distribution for the correctness assertion.

Create tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh (bash harness using source tests/lib/assert.sh). The correctness test invokes: `calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-04` and asserts exact channel counts in stdout.

NOTE: Idempotency (dd-3) is OUT OF SCOPE. Quarterly (dd-2) is OUT OF SCOPE. Those are separate tasks.

## TDD Test Spec
Given: synthetic fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/ with a known detected_by channel distribution (e.g., tests:3, review-llm:2, user-report:1)
When: calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-04 is invoked
Then: emitted rollup contains exact channel counts matching the fixture distribution AND begins with marker <!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-04 kind=monthly --> AND script defines exactly one `readonly CALIBRATION_TZ='UTC'` assignment

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Script declares CALIBRATION_TZ as readonly UTC in exactly one location (dd-4)
  Verify: [ "$(grep -c "^readonly CALIBRATION_TZ='UTC'" plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh)" = "1" ]
- [ ] Script handles missing/unknown subcommand gracefully (non-zero exit)
  Verify: ! plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh badsubcmd 2>/dev/null
- [ ] Synthetic fixture directory exists with at least one JSON file
  Verify: test -d tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs && [ "$(find tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs -name '*.json' | wc -l)" -gt 0 ]
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Fixture-driven correctness test passes against the synthetic distribution (dd-1, dd-5)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Monthly --dry-run rollup output contains the comment-marker for the requested period
  Verify: plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-04 | grep -q '<!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-04 kind=monthly -->'
- [ ] Monthly subcommand fails cleanly (non-zero exit) when --fixture path does not exist
  Verify: ! plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture /nonexistent/path --dry-run --period 2026-04 2>/dev/null

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement calibration-report.sh monthly subcommand with UTC constant and synthetic fixture
